The customer is stuck on the highway right now, but they also say the repair we did (RO-187778) has failed for the third time and they are demanding a manager. Under the tie-break, that combination goes to needs_human. Roadside assistance goes in as a secondary type, and the escalation reason is safety because someone is stranded on a road. The customer_request and complaint reasons also apply, but only one reason can be given, and the stranded car is the most urgent.
